'''''Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – Saber for Hire''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries published as part of ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' Phase III. The series was written by [[Cavan Scott]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in [[2024]].<ref name="Reveal" />
